data.one_liner: A texture helper providing high and low level APIs to handle BGRA data for Flutter.
data.what_it_does: Brings high and low-level APIs to handle BGRA data for Flutter textures on desktop platforms. Uses OpenGL implementations to achieve hardware acceleration and minimize frame copying.
use_when: You need high-performance BGRA/RGBA rendering on desktop platforms like Linux, Windows, or macOS.
You are streaming or processing video/image frames that require native performance via FFI.
avoid_when: You are building for mobile or web platforms (only Windows, macOS, and Linux are supported).
You do not need low-level raw texture rendering.
strengths: Provides both Dart method channel and native FFI APIs for extreme performance optimization.
Hardware-accelerated rendering using OpenGL for desktop platforms.
Only one time frame copy required.
weaknesses: Limited to desktop platforms (Linux, Windows, macOS).
Requires manual lifecycle management of native buffers when using the native FFI API.
data.setup_notes: Requires ensuring BGRA format is used for all platforms and managing buffer lifecycles if using the native API.
